<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/customers/{cus}/excess_payments"}
#docs
Each payment that left money on the customer's excess balance and still holds some: `held_minor` is what it put there less what its refunds drew out; `refundable_minor` caps that by the customer's excess balance in that currency now. Refund one with `POST …/payments/{pay}/refund`. Integer minor units.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `cus` | `string` | **yes** | The customer's id (cus_…). |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The items. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type; always `excess_payment`. One of `excess_payment`. |
| `data.payment` | `string` | The payment id. |
| `data.invoice` | `string` | The invoice the payment was made against. |
| `data.currency` | `string` | The currency code. |
| `data.payment_amount_minor` | `integer` | The payment amount in minor units. |
| `data.held_minor` | `integer` | The part of the payment still held as excess credit, in minor units. |
| `data.refundable_minor` | `integer` | The part that you can refund now, in minor units. |
| `data.gateway` | `string` | The payment gateway key. |
| `data.created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the payment was created. |

## Status codes

|---|---|
